notes.title: Version 1.2.1 Changelog
notes.notes: [p][b]v1.2.1[/b][/p][list][*][p]Allow to filter the ships distribution throughout the galaxy by the player own ships[/p][/*][*][p]Show estimated travel time at the ship current position for long distances too. Keep the time inside the camera view if possible[/p][/*][*][p]Show the repair rate of the Repair Vessel in the ship stats[/p][/*][*][p]Improve the contrast of the tutorial indicator with the background[/p][/*][*][p]Precursor items build progress no longer resets when the Research Vessel undocks or is destroyed[/p][/*][*][p]For short distances, ships travel times are no longer visible if it is not possible to calculate the time with precision. That happens when not all systems in the travel path are loaded on the client side, which does not allow to account for all the disruptors that might affect the time. For long distances an approximated time will still be visible with a ≥ prefix[/p][/*][*][p]To prevent accidental self-destruction of ships, the button is now only visible if the ships were explicitly selected with a selection box or by clicking on them directly[/p][/*][*][p]Fix ships receiving damage after entering warp, if they were directly set as a target by the opponent, and an allied ship remains inside the system[/p][/*][*][p]Fix ships being difficult to select when the camera is in the 2 far away zoom levels[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 1.1.3 Changelog
notes.notes:
[b]v1.1.3[/b]
[list]
[*]Allow to fulfill buy orders that are not in range of the currently selected terminal but are in range of other terminals
[*]Allow to define the fire mode of ships leaving shipyards and market terminals
[*]Cycle over ships in the same position by clicking multiple times
[*]Increase radius of places where new pirates packs can form
[*]Increase market orders radius for orders generated by systems, and further increase their value closer to the solar system
[*]Fix ships showing as duplicated in some situations when the network connection temporarily slows down
[*]Fix ships leaving the market terminal showing as duplicated
[*]Fix ships stopping on positions already occupied by another ship when they receive instructions to stop
[*]Fix camera movement between zoom levels moving too fast when running at a frame rate above 60
[*]Fix repair vessel sometimes not moving to the closest ship when there is none in range to repair
[*]Fix repair vessel repairing ships that are still in warp
[*]Fix ships becoming unselectable if a planet or star is below them
[*]Fix dyson swarm selection indicator not remaining over the ship as it orbits a star
[*]Fix system summary text getting truncated when there are a lot of players in the same system
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.1.2 Changelog
notes.notes:
[b]v1.1.2[/b]
[list]
[*]Allow to filter Logs by other players. Accessible from their Civilization dialog
[*]Ship stats now show values with units
[*]Allow to select and copy (ctrl+c) chat messages, player name and production values on civilization dialog, planets and stars names on their dialog
[*]Improve tutorial text
[*]Increase the initial system minimum distance to the solar system and only start where there are empty adjacent systems to expand to
[*]Fix dialogs title bar being hidden if the game window is resized below their width and height
[*]Fix planet sometimes not visible in the planet dialog the first time it is open
[*]Fix dropdowns list not opening with the correct item highlighted
[*]Fix game window default size after changing to Windowed mode for being too small to fully show some dialogs
[/list]

notes.title: Stardust Exile Demo Release Announcement
notes.notes:
In preparation for Steam's Real-Time Strategy Fest, the demo of Stardust Exile has been released.

Get it here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3411960/Stardust_Exile_Demo/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3411960/Stardust_Exile_Demo/[/url]

Feel free to share it with friends that are into the RTS genre. And reach out via Discord, Steam Discussions or social media channels.

notes.title: Version 1.1.1 Changelog
notes.notes:
[b]v1.1.1[/b]
[list]
[*]Allow to automate outpost location search
[*]More tutorial improvements
[*]Add support for demo client
[*]Once a disruptor enters warp, it no longer has any effect on other ships
[*]Base materials production increased by 50% for planets. Collectors in orbit now on average harvest 52% of available materials, outpost established 24% and upgrades 24%
[*]Increase storage ships base capacities. Materials storage increases to 21M, Gas Tanker to 9.5M and Energy Accumulator to 27M. Increase Shipyard storage base capacities to 4.2M materials, 1.9M gas and 5.4M energy
[*]Change the initial shipyard to have extra-solar capabilities by default. Increase initial resources to 4.2M materials, 1.9M gas and 5.4M energy
[*]Fix allowing to attack ships still in warp when 2 players in the same alliance share the same system
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 Changelog
notes.notes:
Update 1.1.0 released today adds the ability to repair ships, tutorial improvements and several bug fixes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42125517/a6e5a0941ab8d82e1bb15556422c381cab17bfb8.png[/img]

[b]v1.1.0 Changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*]Add Repair Vessel
[*]More tutorial improvements and allow to restart it
[*]Change trajectory color if ship can harvest from planet, star or asteroid belt
[*]Always open objectives dialog if some of the tutorial objectives have not been completed yet
[*]Increase Research Vessel speed and reduce construction time
[*]Reduce Disruptor and storage ships construction time
[*]Fix connection drops not detected in some situations
[*]Fix projectiles weapons sound that sometimes keeps playing after the battle has ended
[*]Fix coordinates buttons and ship focus button not working when in the galaxy view
[*]Fix camera not moving to initial system when starting a new game if the camera is in the galaxy view
[*]Fix ships trails positioned outside of the ship when they have a horizontal or vertical design
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.10.2 Changelog
notes.notes:
Update 0.10.2 released today rebalances weapons damage to make ships with missiles or projectiles more effective against gauss. You can now configure keyboard keys on the settings dialog. And the skirmish game speed is now controllable with keyboard keys. The tutorial was also improved.

[b]v0.10.2 Changelog:[/b]
- Allow to configure keyboard keys
- Allow to control skirmish speed with keyboard keys
- Improve tutorial
- Skirmish opponents ships now have the colors of their faction to help differentiate them from the player own ships during battles
- Rebalanced weapons damage to make ships with missiles or projectiles more effective against gauss
- Fix skirmish mode with seed 0 blocking when moving to the galaxy zoom level
- Fix wrong main menu button text after exiting a skirmish game without a playable faction
- Fix incorrect engine trail color for ships from other players
- Fix gauss shot path sometimes not visible

notes.title: Version 0.10.1 Changelog
notes.notes:
[b]v0.10.1[/b]
- Improve responsiveness when running skirmish at 100x
- Improve performance rendering many ships and trajectories with camera zoomed out
- Improve systems creation time when moving the camera
- Limit total amount of resources in pending market sell orders to 1B
- Fix shipyard and market terminal rally point indicator not moving as the ship moves
- Fix some ships staying in place when moving several at the same time and some of their trajectories go over a corner between systems
- Fix ship selection indicator and mouse over ship indicator being hidden on some zoom levels
- Fix incorrect rendering on some GPUs for: ships, trajectories, planets trajectory lines, over indicator, selection indicator and weapons range line
- Fix some animations moving too fast on frame rates above 60
- Fix establish outpost buttons not being disabled immediately after establishing an outpost if there are no resources to build another

notes.title: Version 0.9.0 Changelog
notes.notes:
[b]v0.9.0[/b]
- Allow to configure rally point of Shipyards and Market Terminals
- Add black hole at the center of the galaxy
- Improve system creation time for systems with many ships
- Improve precision of galaxy map mouse clicks, camera icon position and ships distribution cells
- Improve control borders player names looks
- Fix displayed production rates not updating immediately after a storage ship enters a new system
- Fix production rates not updating when a storage ship or shipyard is bought from the market

notes.title: Version 0.8.0 Changelog
notes.notes:
New update adds NPC Pirates with corresponding bounties for each pirate faction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42125517/d5fe5e2d26e8e79fd542368f4ebc4e251352d318.jpg[/img]
[h3]--------[/h3]
On the galaxy view it is now possible to see the distribution of ships throughout the galaxy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42125517/1852368eaf45342e12d429f68b2e8bb038dc434e.jpg[/img]
[h3]--------[/h3]
Systems under player control now display a border delimiting their territory with an indicator of which systems are protected by disruptors and which are not.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42125517/d3e4f1b920caf7d16bb21903358678a6796586b6.jpg[/img]
[h3]--------[/h3]
Market orders have also been expanded to be automatically generated in other systems besides the Solar System.

[b]v0.8.0 changelog:[/b]
- Allow to see the distribution of ships throughout the  galaxy
- Add Pirates
- Add systems control borders
- Expand automatic market orders generation to more systems
- Fix visual problems with trajectories, trails, gauss shot and dyson laser on systems far away from the solar system
- Show correct planets max resources output based on the player current completed harvest research
- Fix objectives reverting to previous state for some players
- Fix planets and systems text not updating with correct materials production immediately after an outpost is constructed or upgraded
- Fix stars and planets names not being fully displayed when a lot of wide characters are used
- Fix formatting problem in planets temperature field when it is negative
- Fix sell orders table title being removed after the data was received
- Fix price scale formatting problem in market historical prices graph
- Fix Alliances and Bounties dialogs being outside of view after the window is resized
- Fix incorrect sort on the ship specific columns in the markets dialog
- Fix missing system coordinates in logs of type Transaction

[b]v0.5.1[/b]

- Fix pending market buy orders not counting towards the ships limit
- Fix visual problems with New Market Order dialog for some languages
- Fix already removed preset being loaded by default in the Create Ship Class dialog
- Small fixes to translations
